Convert a co-occurrence network to an igraph graph

Source: R/converters.R
as_igraph.Rd

as_igraph() converts a co-occurrence network to an igraph object. igraph is the most widely used general-purpose network library in R, with functions for centrality, community detection, paths and layouts; the conversion makes all of them available without re-entering the edges.

The result is a weighted graph with one vertex per item, isolates included, and one edge per row of the edge list, carrying the edge attributes weight and count. The graph is undirected, except for similarity = "relative", where each row is a directed edge and the graph is directed.

A result built with split_by holds several networks; group names the one to convert, since stacking them would create one parallel edge per group. For a tbl_graph, use as_tidygraph().

Usage

as_igraph(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'cooccurrence'
as_igraph(x, group = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

A cooccurrence edge list from cooccurrence(), with default or "gephi" column names.

...

Passed to igraph::graph_from_data_frame(), apart from directed and vertices, which are set here.

group

For a result built with split_by, the name of the group to convert. NULL (default) for an unsplit result.

Value

An igraph object with one vertex per item (vertex attribute name) and one edge per row of the edge list (edge attributes weight and count). Directed for similarity = "relative", undirected otherwise.

Conditions

cooccure_missing_package when igraph is not installed; cooccure_grouped_input when x was built with split_by and group is NULL; cooccure_bad_input for an unknown group.

See also

as_tidygraph() for a tbl_graph; as_cograph() and as_netobject() for the cograph and Nestimate classes; as_matrix() for the weight matrix.

Examples

net <- cooccurrence(movies, field = "genres", sep = ",",
                    similarity = "jaccard", min_occur = 50)
if (requireNamespace("igraph", quietly = TRUE)) {
  g <- as_igraph(net)
  igraph::strength(g)
}
#>      Action   Adventure   Animation   Biography      Comedy       Crime 
#>   0.9045285   0.7396102   0.5941691   0.6762096   0.7860438   0.7275008 
#> Documentary       Drama     History       Music     Romance    Thriller 
#>   0.5079317   0.9949722   0.4323294   0.3200247   0.4693573   0.4428561
